# Studentkare (SA Care)

> Enterprise Student Health, Emergency 108 SOS, ABDM Interoperability & AI Operations Platform for Indian Universities.

## System Capabilities
- [Emergency 108 SOS](https://studentkare.in/flow-06): Lockscreen offline encrypted PWA pass for emergency responders.
- [Digital Health Vault](https://studentkare.in/vault): ABDM HIU/HIP consent-gated FHIR R4 health timeline.
- [Campus OPD Booking](https://studentkare.in/care): Live station wait times, NMC e-prescriptions & Jan Aushadhi generic alternatives.
- [Syndromic Outbreak Radar](https://studentkare.in/campus): Hostel epidemic R0 transmission radar with k>=20 anonymity floor.

## Compliance & Architecture
- [Privacy & DPDP Act 2023](https://studentkare.in/flow-04): Granular consent, zero AI model training guarantee (Rule-C).
- [Two-Plane Security Isolation](https://studentkare.in/super-admin): Strict database role isolation between clinical and operational data (Rule-K1).

## Open Source Stack & Integrations
- [HAPI FHIR R4](https://hapifhir.io): NRCES India FHIR R4 schema validator.
- [Red Hat Kogito / Drools DMN](https://drools.org): Rule-K5 deterministic claims adjudication engine.
- [Harvard OpenDP](https://opendp.org): Differential privacy budget manager (epsilon=0.5).
- [Ollama / LocalAI](https://ollama.com): On-premise air-gapped LLM inference runner.
